newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded, few offers posted.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded, few offers posted.

text.p: The IPE natural gas contract did not trade on Friday morning after a busy session on Thursday when 225 lots were done.

The market was well bid at the midday close of the morning session, but offers were few and far between. Bids were posted in each of the 12 monthly contracts, but offers were only there in the front three months and December.
Front month August was bid at 9.20 pence a therm and offered at 9.40 pence by the close of the morning session. The month had previously settled at 9.30 pence a therm.
